hooks.command: nl=$(printf "\nx"); nl=${nl%x}; cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); case "$cmd" in *"git push"*) root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; out=$(cd "$root" && npx --yes tsx@4 packages/engine/regen.ts --check 2>&1); code=$?; if [ "$code" -ne 0 ]; then reason="regen.ts --check failed — committed artifacts have drifted from what the engine emits. Run: npx tsx packages/engine/regen.ts, review + commit the diff, then push again.${nl}${nl}${out}"; jq -n --arg reason "$reason" "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:\$reason}}"; fi ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac
hooks.statusMessage: Checking committed artifacts haven't drifted before push…

hooks.command: nl=$(printf "\nx"); nl=${nl%x}; root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root"; git fetch origin main --quiet 2>/dev/null || exit 0; counts=$(git rev-list --left-right --count HEAD...origin/main 2>/dev/null); ahead=$(echo "$counts" | awk "{print \$1}"); behind=$(echo "$counts" | awk "{print \$2}"); if [ -n "$behind" ] && [ "$behind" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then stat=$(git diff --stat HEAD...origin/main 2>/dev/null | tail -6); msg="This branch is $behind commit(s) behind origin/main (and $ahead ahead). Diffstat since divergence:${nl}${stat}"; jq -n --arg msg "$msg" "{systemMessage:\$msg,hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"SessionStart\",additionalContext:\$msg}}"; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Checking branch is current with origin/main…
